title: David Conquers Rabbah
description: Joab leads the army out and besieges Rabbah, the capital of the Ammonites, while David remains in Jerusalem. When the city is captured, David comes and takes the king's gold crown, which weighs a talent, and places it on his own head. He brings out great plunder from the city and sets its inhabitants to work with saws, iron picks, and axes, before returning to Jerusalem. [ref:1 Chr 20:1-3|1 Chronicles 20:1-3]
